newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady on exporters' demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady on exporters' demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained steady on Wednesday mainly on demand from exporters and are likely to hover around the same level until arrival of the 1997/98 (July-June) crop picks up, dealers said.

"Prices are steady because exporters are again on the buying side," dealer Kishan Chand said. But the rates will sag once the new crop supply, expected in the first or second week of July, increases in the market, he said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded between 2,000 ($49.39) and 2,050 rupees per maund (37.32 k.g), dealers said.
